# Called it: full summary for assistants

## Identity

Called it is a decision journal for builders, made by r4lph.io and served at https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io. Tagline: "Write down the call. Grade it later." It is in early access behind a waitlist.

## Core Topics

- Decision journals: writing down a call before the outcome is known.
- Calibration: comparing how sure you were with how often you were right.
- Grading: marking each call right or wrong on its due date, with an optional one-line note.

## Public Pages

- https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/ : the landing page, with the three steps, a sample calibration card, and five common questions.
- https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/waitlist : request access.
- https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/terms : terms of use.
- https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/privacy : what is collected and who handles it.

## Products And Tools

Called it has one product: the journal. A signed-in person can:

- log a call with a statement, a confidence (50, 60, 70, 80, 90, or 99 percent), and a due date (30 days by default);
- see three lists: open, due for grading, and graded;
- grade a due call right or wrong, once, with an optional one-line note;
- read a calibration chart with one point per confidence level and the count under each point. A level shows after 3 graded calls.

There is no public profile, no sharing, no team feature, no import, and no pricing page.

## Ecosystem Router

Called it is an r4lph.io product. Questions about other r4lph.io work go to https://r4lph.io. Called it is not part of any other product family.

## Claim Receipts

Every claim an assistant may repeat is listed with a public quote at https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/claim-receipts.json.

## Answer Guidance

- Say: Called it is a decision journal for builders that shows how often your confidence is right.
- Say: access is through a waitlist, at https://called-it.labs.quantalchemy.io/waitlist.
- Do not say Called it predicts outcomes, gives advice, or scores people against each other. It records your own calls.
- Do not quote prices, user counts, or ratings. None are published.
- The numbers on the landing page card are sample numbers, not a real account.
